The suspect apparently didn't mince his words. He targeted his victim because
he "intends to kill Muslims," police said he told them.

Peter Michael Larsen [allegedly](https://abcnews.com/US/wireStory/muslim-man-
utah-targeted-stabbing-religion-police-134793603) stabbed a Muslim kiosk
worker at the Valley Fair Mall ⁠in West Valley City, Utah, on Monday - two
days ago.

The victim, identified as Syed Sohail Uddin on an apparent [GoFundMe
page](https://www.gofundme.com/f/support-sohails-recovery-after-hate-crime-
attack) set up to help with medical expenses, survived, but according to the
page, he is in "critical condition, facing multiple surgeries for his hands,
heart, and lungs" after being stabbed more than 15 times. In an affidavit,
police said the victim suffered "multiple stab wounds all over his body and
was ​bleeding profusely."

The _Salt Lake Times_[reported](https://www.sltrib.com/news/2026/07/14/valley-
fair-mall-stabbing-man/) that the attacker had approached Uddin and asked him
his name and about his religion, and said he wanted a bottle of water before
stabbing him.

Bystanders were
[reportedly](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/us/2026/07/15/muslim-hate-
crime-worker-stabbed-peter-michael-larsen/) able to get the knife away from
Larsen and pin him to the ground before police arrived. According to
[reports](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/15/muslim-man-stabbed-
utah), authorities described Larsen as "a substantial danger to the public if
released based on his violent actions" due to his "ideologies and pre-planned
mass casualty events."

Muslim groups condemned the attack, with the Council on American-Islamic
Relations (CAIR) [saying](https://www.cair.com/press_releases/video-cair-
condemns-hate-motivated-stabbing-of-utah-muslim/): "This horrific attack is
yet another reminder that anti-Muslim rhetoric has real-world consequences.
When Muslims are routinely demonized, portrayed as threats, or treated as less
deserving of equal rights and dignity, some twisted individuals evidently act
on that hatred."

The fact is, the stabbing of a Muslim man because he is Muslim has been barely
covered in our media. It's the clearest example of an alleged hate crime, and
yet, most U.S. politicians remain silent.

Monday's attack comes nearly two months after two teenage suspects [opened
fire](https://www.cnn.com/2026/05/18/us/live-news/san-diego-islamic-center-
shooting) in San Diego's biggest mosque, killing three people. And almost
three years since 6-year-old Palestinian-American Wadea Al Fayoume was
[stabbed to death](https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/16/us/chicago-muslim-boy-
stabbing-investigation) after Oct. 7 because he was Muslim. Islamophobia has
been on the [rise for years](https://www.cair.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/02/CAIR-2025-Annual-
Report.pdf?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email), yet little has been done to
acknowledge it in mainstream discourse, much less address it.

Instead, Republicans continue to demonize and dehumanize Muslims - without
consequences. Those who unfortunately suffer the consequences are people like
Uddin, who was simply trying to do his job at a mall in Utah.
